summary: xAI announced Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, an updated speech-to-speech voice model with claimed gains in speech reasoning, transcription accuracy, latency and tool-use reliability, which will become the default grok-voice-latest model on August 5, 2026.

mechanisms.reason: The document states the new model uses substantially fewer reasoning tokens per response than its predecessor for the same or better output.
mechanisms.quote: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 has been trained to be very efficient with reasoning tokens relative to its predecessor.

practices.reason: A released voice model shows stated gains in response latency, transcription accuracy and agentic tool-use benchmarks that a team building voice products could act on.
The release cites third-party benchmark suites (Big Bench Audio, Full Duplex Bench, τ-voice Bench) that a team could use to evaluate speech models, though methodology details are not given.
practices.quote: Speech-to-speech benchmark comparison between Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 and competing models, per Artificial Analysis.

practices.reason: The reasoning-token efficiency gain is a lab-internal training outcome, not a technique an external team could implement on its own stack.
practices.quote: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 has been trained to be very efficient with reasoning tokens relative to its predecessor.

practices.reason: The default model alias will switch versions on a fixed date, requiring teams to pin the old version if they want to avoid the change.
practices.quote: On August 5, 2026, grok-voice-latest will move from grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 to grok-voice-think-fast-2.0 . No action needed to upgrade. To stay on Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0, pin grok-voice-think-fast-1.0 before then.
